verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs claim users can "set up automation rules" so mail is handled the way they want. That is a first-party rule-based automation capability, but it appears only as one marketing line with no detail on triggers, conditions or actions. Zapier connectivity is a third-party integration and the API is a developer building block, so neither adds credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of which events can trigger rules, the conditions and actions available, examples of rule configuration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
